title: simarouba excelsa
intro: Simarouba excelsa, commonly known as the pará tree or Brazilian tree, is a medicinal plant species native to the Amazon rainforest in South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, helping to treat various conditions such as fever, pain, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Simarouba excelsa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Simarouba excelsa, such as gedunin and simalikalactone E, have been identified as key compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
